name: opendesigner
description: OpenDesigner: create a design system with your own AI, one sourced decision at a time.

plugins.name: opendesigner
plugins.description: Eight skills: opendesigner (the interview), opendesigner-extract (learn from a reference without copying identity), opendesigner-extend (change a system safely), opendesigner-export (code, Figma, Paper), opendesigner-illustrate (open-licence illustrations recolored to your tokens), opendesigner-review (check a built UI at every size, theme, state and motion, with measurements and evidence), opendesigner-paint (original art and films painted in code in your palette), opendesigner-preflight (the silly mistakes to check before exporting anything visual).
